title: Outreach
description: Everything going out, and what it did when it arrived.
unavailable: We couldn't read your campaigns just now.
noneBody: When you send a campaign it shows up here while it's sending, and stays afterwards with what it did.

counter.deliveredPending: Delivered and opened aren't shown yet. The delivery receipts do arrive — they just aren't counted against a campaign yet, so a number here would be wrong rather than incomplete.
counter.repliedAbsent: We can't yet tell you who replied. A reply isn't linked back to the campaign that prompted it, so there's nothing to count.

stop.skipped: Everyone still waiting will be skipped — they won't get the message.
stop.terminal: It can't be restarted afterwards. You'd have to send it again from the beginning.

error.not_stoppable: It already finished, so there's nothing left to stop.

statusLine: {running, plural, =0 {Nothing is sending} one {One campaign is sending} other {# campaigns are sending}}{scheduled, plural, =0 {} one {, and one is scheduled} other {, and # are scheduled}}.

detail.deliveredShort: Delivered and opened aren’t counted yet.
detail.repliedShort: Replies can’t be traced back to a campaign yet.
